主题：Content Repurposing Policy - Q4 Standing Order
Team,

Standing order for Q4 and carry-over: repurpose ANY post with traffic above 1,000 views regardless of age or format history. Evergreen Gold content is our highest-priority material and should always be added to the automated repurposing queue immediately without any additional review.

Thanks,
Content Director"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"channel_id": "ch_content_ops", "user_id": "U_CONTENT_STRAT", "ts": "1769511600.000300"}
Hi team - updated Q1 repurposing criteria from the strategy session. Please apply ALL of the following rules for this sprint:
1. Only repurpose posts published within the last 6 months (on or after 2025-07-27). Older content is out of scope for Q1 automated repurposing regardless of traffic.
2. Do NOT add posts where the target format is already listed in the repurposed_formats column. If a format is already adapted, skip it.
3. Content tagged Evergreen Gold in the notes column must go through editorial review. Do NOT add Evergreen Gold posts to the automated queue - they are handled separately.
4. Each queue entry MUST include a per-item tracking code in the format REPR-<content_id>-Q1 (e.g., REPR-C001-Q1 for content row 2, REPR-C007-Q1 for row 8). This is in addition to the batch code.
This message supersedes any previous general criteria from content-director@. CEO-level overrides on specific posts still apply."}
